## 5. The physical operation and a complete bound-entangled output

### The projection is an earned optical instrument

At each mode, the construction uses one local single-photon ancilla, vacuum, two balanced beam splitters and two photon-number-resolving detector outputs.

After the first splitter, one ancilla arm is retained. The other mixes with the unknown input at the second splitter. Accepting detector patterns \((1,0)\) and \((0,1)\) gives

\[
K_\pm
=
\frac12
\left(
|0_{\rm out}\rangle\langle0_{\rm in}|
\pm
|1_{\rm out}\rangle\langle1_{\rm in}|
\right).
\]

A known phase correction makes both branches equivalent. Their combined successful map is

\[
X\longmapsto \frac12P_{01}XP_{01}.
\]

Photon conservation excludes input occupations two and above from these accepted events. The retained output preserves vacuum–one-photon coherence, including when the input is entangled with an untouched reference. The two-pattern normalization and component requirements are established quantum-scissors machinery. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="4"}

On failure, the residual optical mode is dumped and an orthogonal local flag is recorded. The accessible support is

\[
|0,S\rangle,\quad |1,S\rangle,\quad |0,F\rangle.
\]

A laboratory qubit-plus-classical-bit register can realize this three-dimensional support. The flag is counted. Merely producing an unflagged vacuum would implement a different channel.

This realizes \(\Phi_{1/2}\) under the stated ideal component model. Published quantum-scissors experiments support the physical primitive; they do not establish the performance of this new multimode assembly. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="5"}

### The Gaussian source is also constructed

For the concrete example, I used the established four-mode Werner–Wolf PPT-entangled covariance, with added isotropic covariance noise:

\[
V_\eta=\Gamma_{\rm WW}/2+\eta I,\qquad \eta=0.01.
\]

Alice holds modes \(1,2\), Bob modes \(3,4\). The parent covariance and its original bound-entanglement construction are credited to Werner and Wolf. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="6"}

The executable derives a finite preparation circuit from the covariance: thermal inputs, two passive interferometers and four local squeezers.
